I bought a cat litter for ₹ 360 few days back but my kittens have started staying outdoors and I no longer need the litter. So I went there to return it and get two box of wet food, so whatever was the difference I asked to adjust it in the new purchase, they said only 90% of exchange product will be given and 10% will be deducted cos of no bill and that guy said “kidhar aur se bhi liya ho hum ko kya maalum” when I have been regularly buying cat food/litter box/litter etc since last two months. They say go vocal for local, if local treats their customer like this it’s better to buy from amazon or flip kart

Edit
PS:- it’s not about ₹36, it’s about ethics.

featured_reviews.name: Avisek Dasgupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Very thoughtfully designed Ear muffs for the furry buds. Bought it for Charlie, a 3 years old cocker spaniel. Charlie is very comfortable wearing it. Helped quite a lot for him to feel safe during this Diwali with all the fire cracker sounds. The owner, Gauree, was very helpful in sharing measurements and options so that I can choose the correct size for my pet. Definitely recommend.

featured_reviews.name: andrea vaz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bought this for my dog Ichigo who suffers from anxiety. He gets very scared during Diwali and moves under the bed for the whole time period due to the sound of crackers. The ear muffs helped my baby calm down and this Diwali was much more bolder to the sound. He sleeps better with his ear muffs on. They are also very cute. Picture attached

Thank you Gauree and Amaari 💙

featured_reviews.name: Harshada Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Loved the ear muffs I ordered for my lab baby. Prompt no fuss delivery, excellent quality & Gauree is a sweetheart. Will be ordering scarves on his birthday. Loveddd it, highly recommend 😍

featured_reviews.name: Payal Nongbet
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amaari pet products are creative, innovative and made so thoughtfully. The colours of the scarves are vibrant and the material is soft and comfortable. These scarves are of superior quality and come in various sizes. I especially love the fact that the owner can have the same scarves and twin with their pet. I have the pink ice cream one with pom-poms and it looks amazing paired with a plain white shirt on a hot summer day 😍
I gifted a lovely red one to a friend doggie, who absolutely loves it.

featured_reviews.name: veda kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text: I purchased the anti anxiety ear muffs for my pet from Amaari. The ear muffs are soft so she never resisted them and in fact she seems to want them around her ears when there was too much noise of the crackers. I am definitely keeping them handy. Thank you Amaari ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Nandita Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Gauri , of Amaari petwear  is a creative lady, her scarves are just too good. She made a beautiful scarf for my baby Razor . He looked so adorable with the scarf on. She has so many beautiful accessories for our furry friends. Most recommended.

featured_reviews.name: sonika bhasin
featured_reviews.review_text: I got a personalized scarf for my dog from Amaari and absolutely loved it! It’s very pretty, the size was perfect and it was delivered on time.

featured_reviews.name: peshaan kerawalla
featured_reviews.review_text: Amaari truly caters to comfort and style! The scarf was extremely light but still warm enough to offer the right coziness. The scarf looks elegant with bright and vibrant colours. Happy Pet and happy Pet Parent!
